channel.title: Tuned blog
channel.description: News, guides and what's new in Tuned.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.13.0
item.description: Tuned 1.13 adds Tuned accounts, so every device keeps the same playlists and settings, plus new home screen widgets and casting that ends when you close the player.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.12.0
item.description: Tuned 1.12 adds signing in on a TV with your phone, the new channel stack icon, a cleaner player with fit and lock buttons, and remote-friendly screens on TVs and tablets.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.11.0
item.description: Tuned 1.11 is a big one: your own lists beside Favourites, MAC portals, renaming channels, sound delay, background play, lighter mode for slow TV boxes, a new look for Settings, and What's new.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.10.0
item.description: Tuned 1.10 casts saved films and episodes to your TV straight from the phone.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.9.1
item.description: Tuned 1.9.1 makes casting saved films and episodes more dependable.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.9.0
item.description: Tuned 1.9 adds avatars on Who's watching and quick filters on Live TV for sports, PPV, country and language.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.8.0
item.description: Tuned 1.8 makes the player, guide and Settings work with TalkBack and large text, and adds search in Settings.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.7.0
item.description: Tuned 1.7 adds catch-up for plain M3U playlists, media buttons and the Assistant in the player, and makes downloads always wait while you watch.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.6.0
item.description: Tuned 1.6 lets you search Countries and languages as you type, with a couple of tidy-ups in Settings.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 1.5.0
item.description: Tuned 1.5 adds the Google Play build with Tuned Premium, the HQ button, Jump to live, a scroll bar on long lists and a time zone setting for the guide.
